Interface SimulationSourceRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Tenant,Integer>, SimulationSourceRepositoryCustom
public interface SimulationSourceRepository extends org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Tenant,Integer>, SimulationSourceRepositoryCustom
Tenant-scoped source reads shared by historical allocation and simulation initialization.

    transactions

  • Method Details

    • loadTransactions

      @Query(name="SimulationSourceRepository.loadTransactions") List<Transaction> loadTransactions(Integer idTenant, LocalDate exclusiveEnd)
      Reads the ledger of a tenant straight from the database. Callers use SimulationSourceRepositoryCustom.transactions(Integer, LocalDate), which serves the same rows from SimulationLedgerCache while a replay runs on the calling thread. Named query: SimulationSourceRepository.loadTransactions
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose transactions are read
      exclusiveEnd - the first transaction date that is no longer included
      Returns:
      the transactions ordered by date, time and id, with instrument and cash account fetched in the same query

    • loadTransactionsAfterId

      @Query(name="SimulationSourceRepository.loadTransactionsAfterId") List<Transaction> loadTransactionsAfterId(Integer idTenant, Integer idTransaction)
      Reads the transactions of a tenant that were written after the given one, regardless of their date. This is how SimulationLedgerCache catches up with the fills a replay has booked since its last read. Named query: SimulationSourceRepository.loadTransactionsAfterId
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose transactions are read
      idTransaction - the highest id already held; 0 reads the whole ledger
      Returns:
      the newer transactions ordered by date, time and id, with instrument and cash account fetched

    • ledgerFingerprint

      @Query("SELECT COUNT(t) AS rowCount, MAX(t.idTransaction) AS maxIdTransaction FROM Transaction t WHERE t.idTenant = ?1") SimulationSourceRepository.LedgerFingerprint ledgerFingerprint(Integer idTenant)
      Row count and highest id of the ledger of a tenant. Two ledgers with the same fingerprint hold the same rows as long as rows are only ever inserted with increasing ids or deleted, which is what lets SimulationLedgerCache detect a rollback, a deletion or a row that became visible late.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose ledger is described
      Returns:
      count and highest id; the id is null for an empty ledger
